categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the design, development, manufacturing, processing, and sales of flexible printed circuit boards (FPC). It operates in electronic components manufacturing, electronic materials wholesale and retail, wired and wireless communication equipment manufacturing, machinery manufacturing and trading, product design, management consulting, and international trade. The focus is on multi-application flexible printed circuit boards serving various industries including consumer electronics, communications, automotive electronics, and medical devices.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies such as multi-layer dynamic bending flexible boards, high-frequency and high-speed flexible boards, and microvia HDI (High-Density Interconnect) technology. It employs roll-to-roll automated production lines, digital optical sensing for thickness measurement, and AI-driven process innovations. Key materials include low-loss substrates like LCP, Teflon, and specialized copper foils with ultra-fine lines. The company also integrates smart factory systems including ERP, PLM, MES, and QMS for agile and precise manufacturing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are major international and domestic electronics manufacturers, including those in the smartphone, notebook, tablet, automotive ADAS, smart lighting, AI wearable devices, and 5G communication sectors. The company serves markets in consumer electronics, telecommunications, automotive electronics, medical devices, and emerging fields like virtual reality and AI applications. The top customer accounts for a significant portion of sales but the company actively diversifies its customer base to reduce dependency.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Taiwan and China with manufacturing facilities in Taiwan (Shulin and Taoyuan) and multiple plants in mainland China (Kunshan, Suzhou, Shenzhen). Its sales are concentrated in the United States (42.5%), China (32.3%), Taiwan (10%), and other regions (15.2%). It maintains a global customer base and international supply chain presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream segment of the electronics supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing of flexible printed circuit boards which are key components used by downstream electronics manufacturers. It sources raw materials like copper foil and insulating films from upstream suppliers and delivers finished flexible circuit boards to OEMs and electronics assemblers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing dynamic bending flexible board technology for foldable smartphones, developing low-carbon manufacturing processes, and expanding high-frequency and high-speed flexible board capabilities for AI and 5G applications. The company invests in AI-driven process innovation, smart factory automation, and new market exploration such as exoskeleton bio-patches, collaborative robot sensors, and smart health monitoring wearables. It also emphasizes ESG and sustainability goals including carbon reduction and green supply chain development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of flexible printed circuit boards and related electronic components. The company also engages in international trade and provides design and manufacturing services tailored to customer specifications. Revenue depends on volume sales to major electronics manufacturers and diversified end markets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include leading global flexible PCB manufacturers such as Zhen Ding, Nippon Mektron, M-flex, Flexium, Interflex, Yong Poong, Sumitomo, Fujikura, and others. The company holds a stable position with over 30 years of industry experience, focusing on high-value, high-technology flexible boards and maintaining competitive advantages through R&D, quality, and smart manufacturing. It holds approximately 1.8% of the global flexible PCB market share.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$7.28 billion, a 26% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss of NT$2.6 billion. The company faces challenges from industry overcapacity and intense price competition but has improved net loss compared to prior years. It employs a conservative financial strategy, maintains a solid capital structure, and invests about 5-6% of revenue in R&D to support future growth and competitiveness.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, high-reliability flexible printed circuit boards with advanced features such as dynamic bending durability, high-frequency performance, and multi-layer HDI capabilities. It offers integrated design and manufacturing solutions tailored to emerging applications like foldable smartphones, automotive ADAS, AI wearables, and 5G devices. Its commitment to smart manufacturing, sustainability, and customer service differentiates it in a competitive market.
